answer: Make each identity anchor to one device-bound key certified by a hardware attestation, and make the device answer a fresh epoch challenge inside a short window - a gale of clones cannot share one chip, because each attestation is unique to its silicon and expires with the epoch. New identities start in a low-trust oasis: they earn weight only after several epochs of peer-graded work, so a farm must buy real hardware and wait real time for every fake. Clones sharing one device share one thin slice of influence.
